notes: Monetary figures scaled from published RMB thousands to full CNY units. revenue and parent-attributable net income/equity come from the most recent opened five-year financial summary covering each year.

The Hong Kong annual reports through2021 use IFRS. The2023/2025 reports use PRC Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises; the later five-year summaries restate revenue and certain other comparatives on that basis. This is a genuine series basis change and is not a conversion error.2021 revenue216,142,395 thousand from the2025 summary replaces the earlier IFRS211,299,918 thousand.

operatingIncome is the explicitly published PRC Operating profit line where available; no pre-tax profit/finance-cost reconstruction for IFRS years. capex includes only directly reported purchases of PP&E where that individual line was found; separate intangibles are not summed. Missing totals remain null.

dilutedEPS is taken only where an explicit diluted or basic-and-diluted value is published. Earlier reports explicitly say no diluted EPS is presented when no diluting events exist, and basic EPS is not silently substituted.

Shares, total debt, dividends and employees remain null where no directly compatible annual values were extracted. Period-end issued share capital, weighted-average EPS shares, component debt sums and chart-only rounded cash flow metrics are not substituted. All missing fields are listed in gaps.
